entries.hypothesis: Every load-bearing statistic in this repo is computed from the pinned 12,956-rune stream, but nobody has measured how sensitive any of them is to the transcription. Perturb the stream by k runes and recompute, so that T1's and T2's re-read has a price.
entries.threshold: Pre-registered in PREREG.md §2 before measurement: k*(floor) for 9 published doublet floors (binding = German 0.972 %, round18/L7 §C.2); IoC*N leaving the in-lane uniform-null p99; L2's Bonferroni |z| >= 3.57 on the Delta-spectrum; K-REC = median full-book recovery < 0.90 (L2's own B.3 gate); K-SEP = correct-key p05 below in-lane wrong-key p95. NO fixed score bar used anywhere.
entries.control_detail: PC-3 equivalence: 13 of 13 published statistics reproduced on the unperturbed stream (doublets 86, rate 0.663836 %, IoC*N 0.999874, entropy 4.856504, lag-1 suppression 80.7463 %, s* 0.8128837, extra draws 373.636, delta chi2/df 1.53260, delta max|z| 2.6414 at D=17, line-break doublets 4, line-initial chi2 78.65603). PC-1 planted flip: the adversarial doublet-maximiser matches its closed form EXACTLY at every k in 1..1000. P-COLLAPSE reproduces independent-read/FINDINGS.md §4 (IoC 0.9998->1.1370 vs published 1.00->1.14; doublet 0.6776 %->1.4617 % vs published 0.68 %->1.46 %). gate_F0 re-run in-lane: 20 cases, max score delta 8.88e-15, 0 path mismatches. Map gate: 450/450 located O/A/AE records map to stream positions with the canon rune matching at every one.
entries.null: 400 trials per (model, k) on the summary channels, reported as median with a 5-95 % band; 60-120 replicates per k on the decode channel with an in-lane wrong-key comparison in the same cell; 2,000-draw uniform-rune null for the IoC*N flatness band.

hard_bound_on_the_OAE_family.statement: No O/A/AE confusion, however adversarially chosen, can carry the doublet rate above 1.4357 % -- below the stale 1.50 %, below held-out English 1.483 % and below Latin 1.425 %; it clears only KJV's 1.386 %.

decode_channel_full_book.mechanism: max_skip lets the key run ahead only; once the beam takes a spurious skip at a corrupted rune it can never re-synchronise, so derailment compounds with length

n_skips_channel.statement: I1's n_skips discriminator (418 correct vs 1537 wrong, margin 1119) loses only 1.6 % of its margin at k=450, where the English score has lost half its recovery. It is the transcription-robust ranking channel.

expected_wrong_runes.argument: round19/C3 measures an independent per-glyph reader at 95.56 % on the LP2 typeface (error 4.44 %). R9 disagrees with canon at 3.07 % and frontB at 2.00 % -- BOTH BELOW the reader's own error rate -- so under p_disagree ~= p_reader + p_canon the implied canon error rate is <= 0. The disagreements are fully explained by the instrument.

verdict_by_channel.doublet_deficit_adversarial_bound: DOES NOT HOLD at k=20 -- a bound, not a forecast
verdict_by_channel.flatness_IoC_vs_located_450: DOES NOT HOLD (crosses at k=167); magnitude is 1.9 % of the distance from flat to English

entries.coverage: 62/62 ledger entries and 17 synthesis claims classified by stream-dependence channel, 0 UNKNOWN. 7 perturbation models x 9-14 k values x 400 trials on the summary channels (~20,000 perturbed streams, each SHA-256'd). The targeted arm enumerates its positions EXHAUSTIVELY (all 450 located, all 1,385 family) rather than sampling, and computes its worst case exactly. Decode channel: 3 segment lengths (120 / 400 / 12,956) x up to 14 k values x 60-120 replicates, with an in-lane wrong-key control in every cell.
entries.not_covered: INSERTIONS, DELETIONS and line-order / segmentation errors. Every model here is substitution-only and preserves n = 12,956; an indel re-indexes every downstream position and every S3 layout statistic and is strictly more damaging. Ledger items B-23 (separator audit, 170 of 604 lines, 19 disagreements unread) and H-02 (full-corpus whitespace re-audit) sit in exactly that class and this lane bounds neither. Also not covered: the decode arm uses encipher_keyskip -> fastbeam(max_skip=3), which per L7-B covers ONE rejection-loop implementation and not skip_by_two or free drift -- §5's derail curve should be re-measured under round19/I1's repaired driftbeam. Adjudicator is the English quadgram scorer on the LP1_REAL register only (L7-A power 1.00 there, as low as 0.00 elsewhere); the n_skips channel in §5.1 is the register-free one.

entries.notes: PREREQUISITE THAT BECAME A FINDING: the 450 located O/A/AE disagreements were stored in the segmented-glyph index space of analysis/stones/dataset.npz and had never been mapped into the 12,956-rune stream. The map is stream_pos = offset(global_line) + pos_in_line via stones/pipeline.global_lines(), whose 594 lines concatenate element-wise to lib_numchannel.unsolved(); 450/450 map with the canon rune matching at every one. Positions span 27..12,897 across all 55 pages; the confusion set is A->O 306, O->A 72, AE->A 70, A->AE 2; and the family is 1,385 of 12,956 runes (10.69 %). SECOND NOTE: 'the stream's own unigram collision rate' in L7-C.1 is the UNBIASED estimator (== lp.stats.ioc), not the plug-in sum p_i^2; only the unbiased one returns the published 3.4478 % / 80.746 %.

The map is licensed by the fact that the 594 lines returned by analysis/stones/pipeline.global_lines() concatenate ELEMENT-WISE to lib_numchannel.unsolved() and hash to the PROBLEM.json pin 023312066df471005264b9cbe7997cb77d2a9a6a2dc9b3316d22674023af1585.

entries.hypothesis: The repo's ~10^10 sweep negatives are properties of a DECODE of this exact ciphertext, not of a summary statistic, so they inherit a different and steeper transcription-sensitivity curve than the doublet rate does.
entries.threshold: Pre-registered bar-free endpoints (PREREG §2.6): K-REC = median rune recovery below 0.90 (round18/L2's own B.3 gate value); K-SEP = correct-key 5th percentile below the IN-LANE wrong-key 95th percentile in the same cell. No fixed score bar is used anywhere in this lane.
entries.control_detail: gate_F0 re-run in-lane: fastbeam vs skipdecode.beam_decode, 20 cases at L in {120,400}, max |score delta| 8.88e-15, 0 path mismatches. At k=0 the full-book correct-key decode returns score -4.103 / recovery 1.0000 against a wrong key's -7.320, reproducing round18/L2's B.3 control. At eps=1.0 the correct key collapses into the wrong-key band (PC-2).
entries.null: In-lane wrong-key decode in every cell, same ciphertext, same corruption, 6-120 replicates depending on length.

result.mechanism: max_skip lets the key pointer run AHEAD only. A corrupted cipher rune can induce a spurious skip, after which the beam can never re-synchronise, so derailment compounds with segment length -- the full-book number is the binding one and short-window measurements understate it.
result.consequence: The negatives are not voided: at k=450 the correct key still scores -4.72 against a wrong key's -7.30, so a sweep that RANKS would still surface it. But every sweep in this repo THRESHOLDED, and round18/L2's landmark full-book positive control (-4.098 / recovery 0.9997) is a CLEAN-TRANSCRIPTION result.

entries.coverage: 3 segment lengths (120 / 400 / 12,956) x up to 14 whole-book-equivalent error counts x 60-120 replicates (6 at full book), LP1_REAL and EN_KJV registers, sha256_ctr key family.
entries.not_covered: One decoder transition model (encipher_keyskip -> fastbeam, max_skip=3), which per round18/L7-B covers exactly one rejection-loop implementation and misses skip_by_two and free drift. round19/I1 has since repaired the decoder; this curve should be re-measured under driftbeam's drift_rec preset, whose larger skip budget could absorb either a spurious advance (more robust) or a wrong one (less). One adjudicator register (English quadgram). One key family.

entries.notes: The companion finding is the good news: round19/I1's n_skips discriminator (correct key 418/418 exact, wrong key 1537, margin 1119) loses only 1.6 % of its margin at k=450 and is EXACT up to k=100. Where the English score has lost half its recovery, the language-independent channel has lost almost nothing. Phase 2 storing n_skips per SWEEPROW, as I1 recommends, makes the sweep robust to precisely the uncertainty T1 and T2 are resolving.
